title: Convergence Ecstatic Dance
location: Kenilworth Teen Center,150 Fairgrounds Drive, Petaluma, CA 94952, USA
description:
Join Us for Convergence Ecstatic Dance!

Convergence is the Saturday night dance party you’ve been waiting for: the sultry vibe of low lights, plenty of room on the dance floor to move, no yelling to be heard over the music, no one spilling their drinks on the dance floor. Tune in to the music, your body, your emotions, the flow of the room, and let loose! This is your chance to connect with others and experience the joy of ecstatic dance in a chill, welcoming space. (There’s even a quiet room for stretching and resting.) No experience needed – just bring your energy and wear clothes you can move in. Don’t miss out on this fun, in-person event where the music and your spirit come together!

Convergence is a conscious dance experience centering Queer & BIPOC folks and welcoming allies. All ages, ethnicities, sexualities, gender expressions, and bodies welcome! No: alcohol, drugs, smoking, shoes, devices, talking on the dance floor.

Convergence is a spinoff from the original Ecstatic Dance electronic music. It has expanded to include music you know and love as well as new music. It spans across musical genres including hip hop, reggaeton, Afrobeats, House, and music from around the world that has a driving beat and makes your body move.

Let the rhythm show you how to move, sing along or vocalize if the spirit moves you, dance alone or with a consenting partner. Use this as a sacred time to get in touch with your emotions, release the ones that no longer serve you and welcoming in joy, levity, play, and peace.

“Ecstatic Dance is a freeform movement journey, held in a safe and sacred container, & facilitated by a professional DJ. It’s a place where we can be our unique selves, and also connected to a common source.” http://~ecstaticdance.org

So put on your comfy clothes, come alone or grab a friend, and get ready to sweat it out! Experience the wonder of moving together silently in community and using body language to communicate. Come early to help create the space and stay afterwards to talk to the friend you made on the dancefloor and help clean up. Community is built by participating fully together, and we’re excited to connect with you!

location: Downtown Petaluma,20 4th St, Petaluma, CA 94952, USA
description:
Petaluma Fall Antique Faire

The much-anticipated Petaluma Fall Antique Faire returns on September 27, from 8am to 4pm, in Historic Downtown Petaluma. The Faire is located on Western Ave, the A Street Parking lot, and 4th & Kentucky Streets between B Street and Washington Street.

"The Bay Area's Premier Antique Center," Historic Downtown Petaluma will transform into an antique marketplace. Amid the beautiful historic buildings, one-of-a-kind stores, an incredible array of restaurants and cafes, guests can find an incomparable selection of affordable antiques from over 200 dealers. The show has a fantastic variety of estate jewelry, linens, furniture, art, kitchenware, vintage décor, books, and all kinds of unusual collectibles to suit everyone's budget.

Antique and collectible lovers throughout the Bay Area are welcome to browse and shop the 40th Annual Petaluma Antique Faire set in our delightful and relaxing downtown Petaluma.

This show attracts over 8k discerning collectors as well as first-time buyers wishing to collect and invest in real antiques.

Visit http://petalumadowntown.com

title: "Paddle The Petaluma: Turn to The River" Guided Kayak Tour
location: The Floathouse Petaluma,50 Water Street, Petaluma, CA 94952, USA
description:
Paddle the Petaluma: Turn to The River is a relaxed, beginner-friendly guided kayak tour exploring the past, present, and future of Petaluma’s historic waterway. Launching right from downtown at The Floathouse Petaluma https://www.thefloathousepetaluma.org?utm_source=chatgpt.com , this Sonoma County Signature Experience spends about 90 minutes on the water in stable sit-on-top kayaks, traveling a gentle mile-and-a-half route through “Petaluma’s Longest Park.”

Along the way, you’ll raft up at docks around town, fascinating landmarks, and riverfront gathering spaces to hear stories about how this Gold Rush-era “saltwater highway” helped shape Petaluma—and how today’s community is continuing to reinvent and reconnect with the river. This isn’t just a history tour. You’ll also learn about the people, businesses, artists, nonprofits, and river advocates helping shape the waterway’s future right now.

Everything is included in the $75 experience: kayak, gear, knowledgeable local guides, insider river stories, and post-paddle perks at nearby businesses. Finish with plenty of time for brunch, coffee, shopping, or simply hanging out downtown by the water. No experience necessary.

Note: The Floathouse Petaluma is a nonprofit project dedicated to “putting butts in boats and smiles on faces” by offering year-round easy access to the Petaluma River in and on people-powered water craft through rentals, events, classes, lessons and summer camps.

Paddle the Petaluma: Turn to The River is a relaxed, beginner-friendly guided kayak tour exploring the past, present, and future of Petaluma’s historic waterway. Launching right from downtown at The Floathouse Petaluma https://www.thefloathousepetaluma.org?utm_source=chatgpt.com , this Sonoma County Signature Experience spends about 90 minutes on the water in stable sit-on-top kayaks, traveling a gentle mile-and-a-half route through “Petaluma’s Longest Park.”

Along the way, you’ll raft up at docks around town, fascinating landmarks, and riverfront gathering spaces to hear stories about how this Gold Rush-era “saltwater highway” helped shape Petaluma—and how today’s community is continuing to reinvent and reconnect with the river. This isn’t just a history tour. You’ll also learn about the people, businesses, artists, nonprofits, and river advocates helping shape the waterway’s future right now.

Everything is included in the $75 experience: kayak, gear, knowledgeable local guides, insider river stories, and post-paddle perks at nearby businesses. Finish with plenty of time for brunch, coffee, shopping, or simply hanging out downtown by the water. No experience necessary.

Note: The Floathouse Petaluma is a nonprofit project dedicated to “putting butts in boats and smiles on faces” by offering year-round easy access to the Petaluma River in and on people-powered water craft through rentals, events, classes, lessons and summer camps.

title: Santa's Riverboat Arrival & Small Business Saturday
location: River Plaza Shopping Center,54 E Washington St, Petaluma, CA 94952, USA
description:
Santa's Riverboat Arrival

Saturday, November 28, 2026

11:30am - 1:30pm at River Plaza Shopping Center

Santa and Mrs. Claus are coming to town on November 28, the Saturday after Thanksgiving!

When Santa arrives in Petaluma, he leaves his sleigh at home. Instead, he and Mrs. Claus make a uniquely Petaluma arrival - they sail up the Petaluma River on a Lind Marine tugboat and dock at River Plaza Shopping Center on E. Washington to the cheers of excited children!

Starting at 11:30 am, families will enjoy live entertainment while waiting for Santa and Mrs. Claus to arrive! The Christmas couple will arrive around noon and will be welcomed by costumed dancers from the Petaluma School of Ballet’s “Nutcracker.” Santa and Mrs. Claus will make their way across the parking lot to their festive tent outside Taps Restaurant where they will be available for family photos. Be sure to bring your Christmas wish list!

Santa would love to spend all afternoon in Petaluma, but in order to hear from all the good boys and girls all over the world, he will have to be on his way to his next destination at 1:30 pm.

Don’t let the fun stop there! Keep the festive mood flowing by taking your Shop Small swag bag and make the short walk to historic downtown Petaluma to support local shopping. When we all shop small, it's not just for the things we love, but for the businesses we love, for the community we call home, and to help promote local economic growth. Learn more about Small Business Saturday http://shopsmall.com/ and visit the official Small Business Saturday Facebook https://www.facebook.com/shopsmall/ page. And take advance of shop small benefits by using your American Express card by viewing this link here https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/maps?country=US&near=Petaluma,CA&cat=Shop-Small&cl=38.232417,-122.6366524&intlink=us-GABM-Shop_Small_Map .

Visit http://PetalumaDowntown.com for more information!

2027 Butter & Egg Days - Opening Ceremonies

Date: Saturday, April 10, 2027, Noon to 1 pm

title: Butter & Egg Days Parade and Festival
location: Downtown Petaluma,20 4th St, Petaluma, CA 94952, USA
description:
2027 Annual Butter & Egg Days Parade and Festival

Date: Saturday, April 17, 2027

Location: Historic Downtown Petaluma

Step into Petaluma's flowering world of curiosity and delight!

The 2027 Butter & Egg Days Parade will take place Saturday, April 17. Participants and spectators alike to celebrate the magic and charm of our historic town. Colorful floats, costumed participants, and lively performances will celebrate Petaluma’s rich history and agricultural heritage. Join in a day of fun and local pride that promises to delight visitors of all ages!

The Butter & Egg Days festivities kick off on Saturday, April 10 with the Opening Ceremonies at the Petaluma Historical Library and Museum (20 4th St), from Noon to 1pm. The Mayor will read a proclamation honoring the Grand Marshal and Good Egg. Come enjoy this display that shows the heart of our community.

One week later on Saturday, April 17, the Butter & Egg Days Parade steps off at noon and will march through the historic downtown. The parade will showcase over 100 units with approximately 3,000 participants and 200 volunteers. The Kids’ Parade, which precedes the main parade at 11:30am with a procession of preschoolers and primary grade youngsters and their families.

The Butter & Egg Days Parade is surrounded by a Festival that spreads over four city blocks from 10am-5pm offering a wide variety of food, crafts, beverage gardens, two large kid areas, live music, and more! This annual event aims to bring together the community for a day of fun and entertainment.

The following weekend, Downtown Petaluma continues community celebration with the Annual Spring Antique Faire, on Sunday, April 25.

Visit ButterAndEggDays.com http://www.ButterAndEggDays.com for more information.

Happy Butter & Egg Days!!

title: Petaluma Spring Antique Faire
location: Downtown Petaluma,20 4th St, Petaluma, CA 94952, USA
description:
2027 Petaluma Spring Antique Faire

Date: Sunday, April 25, 2027

Location: Historic Downtown Petaluma

The esteemed Petaluma Spring Antique Faire returns on April 25, 2027, from 8am to 4pm, in Historic Downtown Petaluma. The Faire is located on Western Ave, the A Street Parking lot, and 4th & Kentucky Streets between B Street and Washington Street.

"The Bay Area's Premier Antique Center," Historic Downtown Petaluma will transform into an antique marketplace. Amid the beautiful historic buildings, one-of-a-kind stores, an incredible array of restaurants and cafes, guests can find an incomparable selection of affordable antiques from over 200 dealers. The show has a fantastic variety of estate jewelry, linens, furniture, art, kitchenware, vintage décor, books, and all kinds of unusual collectibles to suit everyone's budget.

Antique and collectible lovers throughout the Bay Area are welcome to browse and shop the 41st Annual Petaluma Antique Faire set in our delightful and relaxing downtown Petaluma.

This show attracts over 8k discerning collectors as well as first-time buyers wishing to collect and invest in real antiques.


Visit petalumadowntown.com http://petalumadowntown.com

~ Admission is free ~
